## Context
A documentation-only Gerrit change currently consumes the complete OS/Python pytest matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs even though no executable or configuration behavior changed. The operator explicitly approved a reduced docs-only lane, but configuration and workflow changes must always be treated as code-impacting. The classifier must therefore be fail-closed and allowlist only unambiguously documentary paths. The reduced lane must retain every documentation-related guard, including generated-doc drift, ADR numbering/index/reference validation, docs index completeness, README quickstart/reference checks, CLI/MCP reference drift, env registry drift, and every other documentation guard discovered in the current shared workflow.

## Trust boundary
The routing decision is security-sensitive because it controls which checks feed Verified. Mirror the existing trusted-main vote-normalization boundary in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`: the routing job checks out the classifier implementation and its complete allowlist from `origin/main` with credentials disabled. It derives only a `git diff --name-only` path list for the exact patchset and passes that list as untrusted data to the trusted classifier. It never imports, sources, or executes classifier logic or allowlist configuration from the patchset tree. A patchset that changes the classifier, workflow, action, or any policy/config path therefore selects full Verify. This is an application of the already-established trusted-decision boundary, not a new architectural decision; preserve it in workflow commentary and contract tests.

## Plan
- Inventory every pre-pytest gate currently inline in `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`; record the documentation-relevant inventory in contract tests so a gate cannot silently disappear from docs-only Verify.
- Extract the current inline documentation gates into `.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml`. Remove their inline copies and have both the full pytest matrix and the docs-only job invoke this exact shared composite action. Copying the gate list into a second workflow is forbidden.
- Add a deterministic changed-path classifier for the exact Gerrit patchset. Only allowlisted documentation artifacts select the reduced lane. Any Python, shell, workflow, action, dependency/lock, build, test, fixture, config, policy, or unrecognized path selects the full lane. Empty, malformed, or unavailable diffs also select the full lane.
- Run the routing decision from trusted `origin/main` code as described above. Test the hostile case: a patchset that modifies the classifier or its allowlist cannot select docs-only Verify.
- Route proven docs-only patchsets through one Ubuntu documentation-gate job using the shared action.
- Skip the pytest OS/Python matrix and unrelated mutation, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs only when the trusted fail-closed classifier proves the patchset is docs-only.
- Keep the resolvable-ticket gate, clear-vote, aggregate vote, and all Gerrit secret/security boundaries unchanged.
- Add workflow/config contract tests for classifier behavior, conservative path boundaries, complete docs-gate inventory, both routes, shared-action reuse, and fail-closed aggregation.
- Measure a genuine docs-only workflow wall clock and runner occupancy against change 1778 and record the evidence on this ticket.
- Back-out is a Gerrit revert restoring unconditional full Verify execution.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A change limited to allowlisted documentation paths selects the docs-only lane.
- [ ] A Python file change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A shell or executable script change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A GitHub workflow or action change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A dependency or lockfile change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A test or fixture change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A repository configuration or policy change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] An unrecognized path selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] An empty, malformed, or unreadable diff selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] The classifier implementation and allowlist execute only from trusted `origin/main`.
- [ ] Only the exact patchset changed-path list crosses into the trusted classifier as untrusted data.
- [ ] A patchset modifying the classifier, allowlist, workflow, or action selects full Verify.
- [ ] Current inline documentation gates are extracted rather than copied.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR number validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR index drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR cross-reference validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs docs index completeness validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs README quickstart validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs CLI reference drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs MCP reference drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs env-var registry drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs every other current documentation-related guard found by the inventory.
- [ ] The full Verify lane invokes the same shared documentation-gate action.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run the OS/Python pytest matrix.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run mutation testing.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, or identity jobs.
- [ ] The resolvable-ticket gate still runs for docs-only changes.
- [ ] Verified voting remains fail-closed when classification or documentation gates fail.
- [ ] Workflow policy and config parsing tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and typecheck pass.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit LLM-Review reaches +1; evidence is the change id, patchset, vote, and timestamp recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit Verified reaches +1; evidence is the change id, workflow run, patchset, vote, and timestamp recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The change merges before this ticket closes; evidence is the merged SHA and timestamp recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A genuine docs-only Gerrit timing and runner-occupancy comparison is recorded; evidence names the docs-only change and run, change 1778 and run 31817494677 baseline, wall-clock durations, and runner-minutes by job.
